dog.description_text:
Koda

Meet KODA, an adorable 3-month-old Terrier mix who is patiently waiting for someone to choose him. 🥹🐾
What kind of Terrier mix is he?
Your guess is as good as ours. 😂 But we're 100% certain he's mixed with CUTE AS A BUTTON. ❤️
Koda is doing wonderfully in his foster home. He's a sweet, loving little boy who is enjoying life with the other foster dogs and learning all the important things a puppy needs to know.
🐾 3 months old
🐶 Terrier mix — mystery ingredients included! 😂
